menu_options.bridge: Camera bridge (Raspberry Pi + Sony A7 IV)
menu_options.studio: Studio presets (shared preset library and camera sync)

bridge.title: Camera bridge
bridge.description: Address of the Raspberry Pi bridge and the token from /etc/a74-bridge/bridge.env.

console.title: RØDECaster Video
console.description: Address of the console on the studio LAN (control port 10024, no authentication).

studio.title: Studio presets
studio.description: One shared hub for preset save/load and syncing settings between cameras.

error.no_camera: The bridge answers but reports no camera

sync_full.name: Sync full settings from source camera

preset_save.name: Save preset
preset_save.description: Downloads the camera settings file (validated on the bridge) and stores it as /share/camera_presets/<preset>/<camera>.DAT.

preset.name: Preset name
preset.description: Folder name under /share/camera_presets; empty = date and time.

note.name: Note
note.description: Free text stored with the preset.

preset_load.name: Load preset
preset_load.description: Uploads /share/camera_presets/<preset>/<camera>.DAT to the camera. The camera reboots (HDMI drops for about 11 s). Waits for verification.

clock_sync.name: Sync camera clock
clock_sync.description: Reads the camera clock and corrects it from the bridge when it is off by more than 2 s.

force.name: Force
force.description: Correct even when the bridge has no NTP sync.

properties.name: Properties
properties.description: Object of property name (SDK name or alias) to raw value.

record.name: Recording
record.description: Start or stop recording on the cameras and the RØDECaster Video console together (the studio recording mode). Never called from schedules.

jam.name: Jam timecode first
jam.description: Jam time-of-day timecode on the cameras before starting (default on).

fps.name: Frame rate
fps.description: Timecode frame rate for the jam.

timecode_jam.name: Jam timecode
timecode_jam.description: Sets free-run time-of-day timecode on the cameras from the bridge clock (NTP). Refused while recording.

fps.name: Frame rate
fps.description: Timecode frame rate (25 for PAL studios).

preset_list.name: List presets
preset_list.description: Returns the preset library with metadata.

sync_from.name: Sync from camera
sync_from.description: Copies settings from one camera to the others: parameters (exposure, WB, profile, format; no reboot) or full (settings file, reboots the targets).

focus_refresh.name: Refresh focus
focus_refresh.description: Cancels a touch/tracking focus lock so face recognition in the Wide area takes over again. Allowed while recording.

media_list.name: List camera card files
media_list.description: Lists the recordings on the camera cards. The camera leaves Remote mode for about 6 s; refused during a studio session or while recording.

media_upload.name: Upload card files
media_upload.description: Starts a job that sends files from one camera's cards to object storage. The camera cannot be controlled until the job ends; refused during a studio session.

prefix.name: Prefix
prefix.description: Path under the bridge's storage remote (A74_MEDIA_REMOTE), e.g. the booking reference.

files.name: Files
files.description: File names from media_list, or objects {name, folder, dest}.

media_job.name: Card upload job
media_job.description: Returns the current or last upload job of each camera with the state of every file.

media_cancel.name: Cancel card upload
media_cancel.description: Stops the upload, removes the unfinished object and returns the camera to Remote mode.

console_media_list.name: List console ISO files
console_media_list.description: Lists the ISO recordings on the RØDECaster's disk through the bridge that reaches it. Does not touch the cameras.

console_media_upload.name: Upload console ISO files
console_media_upload.description: Starts a job that streams files from the console's disk to object storage. Refused during a studio session.

prefix.name: Prefix
prefix.description: Path under the bridge's storage remote (A74_MEDIA_REMOTE), e.g. the booking reference.

files.name: Files
files.description: Paths from console_media_list, or objects {path, dest}.

console_media_job.name: Console ISO upload job
console_media_job.description: Returns the current or last console upload job with the state of every file.

console_media_cancel.name: Cancel console ISO upload
console_media_cancel.description: Stops the console upload and removes the unfinished object.

data.guard_entity: Session guard entity (while on: no preset save/load/sync, they blank the HDMI output)
